note: Track dim-aug, mix step 3: major, minor, diminished and augmented triads on one root, built on the staff, heard on four chord boxes, then named by ear from any root in the chord game ("qualities": maj, min, dim, aug), which now asks all four, in place of pressing chord boxes without looking. The root is moves (any key), named as {{=key}}, with a {{?key}} line, and each section has a feel to reach.

exercise.title: Major, minor, diminished or augmented
exercise.why: The 3rd makes a triad major or minor, and the 5th stays, drops a half step or rises a half step, so two notes over one root name the four triads.

cells.text:
Tap {{1}}, {{3}} and {{5}} on the staff below, then {{1}}, {{b3}} and {{5}}: {{=key}} major and {{=key}} minor, and only the 3rd moved.
Now tap {{1}}, {{b3}} and the ringed {{b5}} for {{=key}} diminished, then {{1}}, {{3}} and the ringed {{#5}} for {{=key}} augmented: the minor triad with its 5th lowered, and the major triad with its 5th raised.
Practice until you can hum each 5th before you tap it.

Press a chord box below to hear the chord. Go from {{=key}} to {{=key}}aug and from {{=key}}m to {{=key}}dim, then press the four in any order.
Practice until you can hear which way the 5th moved.
{{?key}}On another root the chords have other names, and the 3rd and the 5th still name the triad.

Press Start in the game below: it plays a triad from any root, and you pick Major, Minor, Diminished or Augmented.
Listen to the 3rd first, then to the 5th. If you can't tell, press Replay in the game.
Practice until you name the triad before the chord has faded.
